scientific_invariants.source: improvements/taskrelation/research/proposals/DG-0008_exact_matched_directed_transfer.md### Opportunity and identity manifests — fully declarative specification

value.forbidden: delimiter-joined text or bare sorted digest lists
value.matrix_digest: sha256(J(all entries sorted by (cell UTF-8 bytes, f, s, e)))

value.emission: for each (cell,f,s,e) emit exactly the dg0008.opportunity-manifest.v2 object; step_keys has exactly S[cell,f] batches of exactly 2048 entries and n_er exactly S[cell,f] entries with n_er[k]=n_ER[cell,s,f,e,k]; per-epoch digest = lowercase sha256(J(manifest_object))

value.n_ER: n_ER[cell,s,f,e,k] = count of iemocap entries in step k; epoch index mandatory

scientific_invariants.source: improvements/taskrelation/research/proposals/DG-0008_exact_matched_directed_transfer.md### Reproducibility rule — pinned and fail closed

value.failure: any deterministic-algorithm error or bitwise disagreement is fatal; no tolerance is invented, no held-out endpoint is read
value.held_out: no held-out test result from the repeat is used
value.shares: same five run-manifest epochs, run-level digest, initialization and RNG snapshot
value.target: si_er control, fold 0, seed 0 second execution

value.H1: ER<-SI harmfully negative, ER<-KS practically null, D negative beyond delta
value.H2: both auxiliaries harm ER beyond delta, D practically equivalent to zero
value.H3: both ER-target residuals practically equivalent to zero
value.INCONCLUSIVE: every other valid pattern including opposite signs, a non-null KS cell without H1, or intervals too wide
value.semantics: behavioral pair-selectivity only; no semantic causation or full directionality claim

scientific_invariants.name: sole diagnostic SESOI and strict boundary rule

value.boundary_equality: not success; every region inequality is strict

value.D: paired construction handles between-cell covariance; no zero-covariance assumption in the realized decision
value.folds: nested description only, never 50 independent observations
value.per_quantity: mean, sample SD over the five seed values, half-width t_.025,4 * sd / sqrt(5)

value.H3: for each c in {SI,KS}: mean_T[c]-h_T[c] > -delta and mean_T[c]+h_T[c] < +delta
value.INCONCLUSIVE: every other valid result, including any boundary touch/cross and wide intervals

value.gate_members: four fold-0/seed-0 matrix members are reused, not extra jobs
value.stage1_jobs: 200 five-epoch matrix trainings (2 cells x 2 arms x 5 seeds x 10 folds)

value.S_envelope: within the coarse DG-0001 sanity envelope
value.failure: any failure invalidates execution and is not evidence for or against H1-H3
value.held_out_reads: 0 before all gates and all 200 matrix trainings pass

mismatches in ER key order or n_ER
differences in step count, ER coefficient, LR sequence, initialization hash or pre-forward RNG-state sequence

value.nested: fold-level residuals, held-out-speaker ranges, fold sign counts describe heterogeneity only
value.primary: five seed-level T[SI], T[KS], D with mean/SD/t 95% interval
value.validity: equalities, manifest digests, n_ER and bitwise repeat decide admissibility, not transfer
